Welcome to Lanesend Primary School
Welcome to Lanesend Primary School located in Cowes on the beautiful Isle of Wight.
Our school is filled with delightful children and dedicated, skilled and caring staff - 'Team Lanesend'. Our vision - 'Loving, learning and thriving' - reflects not only our nurturing environment but also our commitment to providing every child with the learning opportunities to make their best possible progress through their Primary School Journey. We aspire for every child to feel nurtured and valued, with a thirst for learning and a recognition of the positive impact they can have on the world as global citizens. Through their learning rich experiences, we strive to create happy memories to last a lifetime.
If you would like to find out more about our wonderful school, please don't hestitate to contact us.

pageCache.text:
Key Info
Ofsted Results and Performance
Our most recent OFSTED report was produced in 2022, to see the report - click below to view: Ofsted Report 2022
You can view our latest parent view survey results here:
Lanesend Primary School | Ofsted Parent View
For our latest results please click here: Compare School Performance:Lanesend Primary School - GOV.UK - Find and compare schools in England (compare-school-performance.service.gov.uk).

Our Children
Starting Reception
Life in Reception at Lanesend Primary School is truly magical. Whilst every day is different, every day is always full of smiles and learning. The children are at the heart of all that we do and every moment of their time in school is so precious as they begin their journey at our school.
We plan and create opportunities and experiences to ignite children's love of learning; from trips and visitors, to pets and performances; cooking and crafting to outdoor learning and sports skills. Our children have opportunities to discover, explore, make, create, sing, dance and, most importantly, learn.
We grow strong relationships with our children and their families and we are proud to support the unique needs of each and every child.
We really do live our vision of ‘loving, learning and thriving’, every moment of every day and we take such pleasure in sharing your child's learning journey with them.
Email admin@lanesendprimary.co.uk if you would like to come and look around our wonderful school.
See below for useful information that you may find helpful:
Home - Starting Reception

Curriculum
Maths
Lanesend Primary School’s Maths curriculum provides our children with the essential life skills they need to find solutions to mathematical problems. and to becoming successful and proficient mathematicians., fluently recall facts rapidly and reason mathematically while justifying their reasoning. This will allow our learners to become financially capable, while understanding and contributing to the world around them. We want them to adopt a belief system of believing they can, overcoming some of the negative barriers that children (and families) often have around the subject.
Our Maths curriculum is based on an adapted version of the ‘White Rose’ scheme, a progressive sequence of learning which is tailored to the needs of each class, developing children’s theoretical, practical and disciplinary knowledge.
We have a school-wide vision that all children can succeed, understanding the needs of individual learners and the depth of knowledge they’re capable of reaching.

Curriculum
Music
Lanesend Primary School’s Music curriculum provides our children with opportunities to feel that they are musical, to develop a life-long love of music and to become real musicians. We want children to learn about music from all around the world and across generations, teaching children to respect and appreciate the music of all traditions and communities. Children participate in a progressive sequence of learning, allowing them opportunities to sing, explore tuned and untuned instrumental work, develop compositions, and to listen, appreciate and respond to both live and recorded music. All children are taught the skills to be able to compose using musical instruments. From an early age, children are exposed to graphic scores to aid their notation of sounds. Then, when the children are ready, formal musical notation is taught and children are taught correct musical terminology. It is our aspiration that all children will be able to read and understand music notation by the time they leave Lanesend Primary School, and that they continue their learning journey with a love and passion for music.

Curriculum
Science
Lanesend Primary School’s Science curriculum aims to develop a sense of excitement and curiosity about natural phenomena and familiar and unknown observations. Children will develop an understanding of how the scientific community contributes to our past, present and future and how they could contribute. We want children to develop their knowledge of biology, chemistry and physics alongside their skills in working scientifically. Our curriculum ensures secure progression by building on practical and investigative skills. We provide opportunities for children to explore Science in inclusive and meaningful ways so that they experience the joy of science and make associations between their science learning and their lives outside the classroom. Our curriculum encourages children to appreciate how science is fundamental to solving many global challenges, encouraging critical thinking and empowering them pupils to question the world around them.

Our Children
Breakfast Club
Our Breakfast Club opens from 7:30am Monday to Friday, during term time (excluding development days). The Breakfast Club is based in The Squirrel's Den and the children are cared for by our own staff and taken to class for registration. We provide breakfast consisting of choices of cereal and toast with a variety of spreads. Milk and water are provided to drink, even hot chocolate on those cold winter mornings!
The cost is £4 per session per child.
We do ask that your child is booked into our Breakfast Club, bookings can be made via Arbor.

Curriculum
Curriculum, Teaching and Learning
Our vision for our curriculum is that Lanesend Primary School provides an inclusive and nurturing environment where every child is empowered to fulfil their potential. Through our core values of pride, belonging and respect, children thrive and celebrate their achievements, embracing challenges with courage and resilience. Children secure the knowledge and skills to become happy and successful life-long learners, contributing confidently to the world in which they live.
We teach all subjects discretely but make meaningful links between subjects to enhance children’s learning. For phonics, we follow the Little Wandle scheme and our writing curriculum is based on Talk for Writing whilst we use White Rose as a basis for our maths' learning. For most of our wider curriculum subjects, we use Kapow as a basis for for our curriculum. For French we use Language Angels while for PE we use Get Set 4 PE. Explore our curriculum in more detail by clicking on subject tabs. We enrich our curriculum through a range of visits, trips and experiences.
Click on the tabs below to find out more about each of the curriculum areas. If you would like more information about our curriculum, please contact our Office Team and they will be able to help you.
https://www.kapowprimary.com/

pageCache.pageTitle: Lanesend Primary School - Our After School Enrichment Clubs
pageCache.text:
Our Children
Our After School Enrichment Clubs
As a school we aim to offer a wide variety of After School Enrichment clubs.
We benefit from wonderful clubs which are run by outside professionals such as Skateboarding, Easel Peasels Art, Ballet, Forest Schools, Skates, Irish Dancing and School of Rock Music. The children really enjoy the variety and fun that our enrichment clubs bring!
Enrichment Trips Overview

Curriculum
Art
Lanesend Primary School’s Art and Design curriculum provides our children with the opportunity to explore the world around them and to appreciate its richness and variety. We want children to be inspired by the art and design pieces they explore by a wide range of artists and designers from different times and different cultures. We want the knowledge and skills children learn to contribute to them building the confidence to experiment and explore, creating their very own works of art. Lanesend Primary School’s curriculum is based on Kapow, providing a progressive sequence of learning which develops children’s theoretical, practical and disciplinary knowledge. Through these three domains of knowledge, children generate ideas and use sketchbooks to develop their own artistic identity.

Curriculum
Computing
At Lanesend Primary School, we want to equip our children with the skills and creativity required to change the world. They must use their Maths, Science and Design Technology skills in order to understand computing systems. We want them to be digitally literate on a range of systems so they can be active participants in the digital world. Developing digital resilience is a key aspect of our curriculum, encouraging our children to embrace challenges and build resilience to find answers to problems. We want our children to love computing allowing them to thrive in the modern digital world inspiring the next computer scientists. Lanesend Primary School’s curriculum is based on Kapow, providing a progressive sequence of learning which develops children’s theoretical, practical and disciplinary knowledge. Through these three domains of knowledge, children will build their competence in coding for a variety of practical and inventive purposes, learn about the importance of online safety and net etiquette, use applications and devices in cross curricular lessons and build the ability to collect, organise and manipulate data effectively.

Design Technology

They must use their Maths, Science and Design Technology skills in order to understand computing systems. We want them to be digitally literate on a range of systems so they can be active participants in the digital world. Developing digital resilience is a key aspect of our curriculum, encouraging our children to embrace challenges and build resilience to find answers to problems. Curriculum
Geography
Lanesend Primary School’s Geography curriculum inspires our children to develop their curiosity and fascination for the world and its people. We offer opportunities for our children to explore the world and to appreciate its richness and variety. We want the knowledge and skills the children learn to contribute to their understanding of the human and physical world in which they live and their place within it. We want pupils to develop the confidence to question and observe places, measure and record necessary data in various ways, and analyse and present their findings. Lanesend Primary School’s curriculum is based on Kapow, providing a progressive sequence of learning and aims to promote the children’s interest and understanding about diverse places, people, resources and natural and human environments, together with a deep understanding of the Earth’s key physical and human processes. We hope to encourage pupils to become resourceful, active citizens who will have the skills to contribute to and improve the world around them.
